jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Program Manager

AcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20. Commercial leaders use AcuityMD to identify target markets, surface top opportunities, and grow their business. By combining real-world healthcare data with AI-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. AcuityMD ranked No. 316 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in America and was named to Forbes’ 2025 “Next Billion-Dollar Startups” list – an elite group of 25 venture-backed U.S. companies identified as most likely to reach a $1 billion valuation.‍ AcuityMD is backed by Stepstone Group, Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, ICONIQ, and Atreides Management.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring our largest, most strategic accounts have a world-class experience on the AcuityMD platform. These customers represent the most complex organizations, technology portfolios, and technical requirements. They also represent the greatest opportunity for our company to have a positive impact on their businesses and on the world, as they bring diverse and impactful medical technology to the patients in need.

The customers that the Program Manager will be responsible for are often in a constant state of implementation, as they deepen their initial adoption of and repeatedly expand their use of AcuityMD to more and more of their business units. You will partner closely with sales executives, solutions engineers, customer success managers in the Enterprise and Strategic segments to ensure a cohesive experience for these critical customers.

Team Mission

The Professional Services team is part of a tightly integrated commercial organization that is responsible for the end-to-end customer experience from initial sale and implementation through ongoing application support, success, and expansion.

We provide a frictionless project experience, which is an essential part of ensuring AcuityMD customers are thoroughly supported throughout their journey with us. We strive to turn our customers into true partners and “raving fans.” We focus on making our customers successful, and they will ensure that we are successful.

Responsibilities

- Oversee Strategic customers throughout their implementation journeys

- Partner with account executives and solution engineering to scope, price, and successfully position/sell services for implementation, integration, and ongoing premium success

-

Partner with customers to understand their existing technology stack and AI roadmap; develop and own a joint transformation plan that ensures they can successfully adopt, scale, and govern AI-powered workflows within the AcuityMD platform.

- Project manage the implementation programs for our largest customers

- Lead the setup, configuration, and testing of the AcuityMD platform for new clients to ensure proper functionality

- Coordinate internal and external resources to manage changes to the project scope and schedule for the flawless execution of projects

- Provide client support until the implementation has been completed and the customer is transitioned to the Customer Success Team

- Be a strategic partner to the Account Executive team and Customer Success team removing technical blockers with urgency and jumping into customer conversations when needed

- Partner with the engineering team to efficiently and effectively activate standard and custom integrations with customer CRM, ERP, and data lake.

- Partner with AEs and CSMs to ensure our customers’ long-term success

- Ensure the effective integration of key data between the AcuityMD platform and key customer systems

- Serve as an escalation point for customer issues and feedback, helping to coordinate resources as needed to drive timely resolution and response

- Be a key player in establishing the Professional Services business as a revenue generator with a clear path to positive margin

- Be a Builder - develop, refine, and continuously improve our enterprise and strategic playbooks and collateral for implementations

- Be a Bar Raiser - set a new standard for what great looks like and help others achieve it; level-up the healthcare, medical billing, and medtech industry knowledge of the team

- Be a Curious Learner - show genuine interest in learning about our customers’ science, technology, and business imperatives; engage empathetically with internal colleagues to develop and improve processes, culture, and relationships

Your Profile

- Bachelor’s Degree required

- Preferred focus areas: healthcare administration, science, engineering

- 10+ years customer-facing experience

- 5+ years leading large scale customer implementation programs in highly complex and technical environments

- Startup experience preferred

- Strong leadership skills, with a documented record of leading high performing project teams

- A documented history of building strategic relationships with customer stakeholders at all levels

- Exceptional project management and organizational abilities

- You are fluent in technical concepts and have experience working closely with product management, engineering, and technical integration teams; you have an aptitude for explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- You are an excellent relationship-builder who builds credibility with team members at all levels, including executives.

- Excellent communication skills, capable of influencing at all organizational levels.

- Previous experience

- Experience in healthcare and enterprise SaaS are must-haves

- Experience in medtech or biotech are nice to have

Nice to Haves

- Advanced degree in business or healthcare administration

- Project management certified

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base salary range: $170,000-$240,000

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA to be considered for this position

We Offer:

- Ground floor opportunity : Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).

- Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.

- Remote work : AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.

- Flexible PTO : Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.

- Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.

- Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.

- Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.

- Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.

We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

AcuityMD is an Equal Opportunity Employer

AcuityMD is seeking to create a diverse work environment because all teams are stronger with different perspectives and life experiences. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of AcuityMD are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.

Strategic Finance Manager

AcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20. Commercial leaders use AcuityMD to identify target markets, surface top opportunities, and grow their business. By combining real-world healthcare data with AI-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. AcuityMD ranked No. 316 on the  2026 Inc. 5000 list  of the fastest-growing private companies in America and was named to  Forbes’ 2025 “Next Billion-Dollar Startups” list  – an elite group of 25 venture-backed U.S. companies identified as most likely to reach a $1 billion valuation.‍ AcuityMD is backed by Stepstone Group, Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, ICONIQ, and Atreides Management.

You’ll join a high-impact Strategic Finance & FP&A team that sits at the center of decision-making at AcuityMD. Our team helps leadership understand where the business is going, how we should allocate resources, and what actions will create the most long-term value.

This is a generalist finance role with a Strategic Finance orientation. You’ll work across financial analysis, strategic projects, planning, AI-enabled transformation, business performance, and procurement. Rather than owning one narrow process, you’ll tackle a changing set of high-priority problems across the business.

You’ll have meaningful ownership from the start, independently driving analytical and cross-functional work-streams while partnering closely with senior Finance and company leaders. This role is ideal for someone with strong financial and analytical judgment who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, forming a point of view, and translating analysis into decisions and action.

Team Mission

FP&A exists to bring financial clarity and strategic discipline to AcuityMD. We turn data into insight and insight into action—enabling leadership to make smarter, faster decisions. Our team drives the planning and forecasting processes that align resources with company priorities, and we ensure financial rigor across departments through modeling, reporting, and business partnership. In a fast-scaling environment, we act as both stewards of financial performance and architects of scalable processes. We’re not just tracking the numbers—we’re helping shape the future of the company.

What You’ll Do

- Strategic Analysis & Business Partnership: Independently tackle high-priority questions across the business, including AI costs and ROI, market opportunities, new products, pricing and packaging, and strategic investments. Partner cross-functionally to structure ambiguous problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and turn imperfect data into clear recommendations and decisions.

- Financial Modeling & Forecasting: Own key areas of forecasting, headcount and spend planning, and financial modeling. Build and improve driver-based models that help leadership understand performance, evaluate scenarios, and make informed decisions around growth, efficiency, and investment.

- AI Transformation & Automation: Help build the next generation of Finance infrastructure at AcuityMD. Improve data quality and connectivity across systems, and develop AI-enabled workflows that make Finance faster, more accurate, and more scalable. Redesign processes and automate repetitive work to create capacity for higher-value analysis and decision support.

- Business Performance & Insights: Analyze financial and operational performance, identify key drivers and leading indicators, and translate findings into clear recommendations. Define and track the metrics and KPIs that matter most to the business, and build reporting and operating cadences that help leadership proactively identify risks, opportunities, and actions.

- Procurement & Spend Optimization: Own and continuously improve procurement processes, tooling, and request workflows. Support vendor evaluations, renewals, benchmarking, and negotiations, while identifying opportunities to reduce costs, optimize licenses, eliminate redundant tools, and improve spend efficiency.

What We’re Looking For

- Experience: 5–7 years of experience across investment banking, management consulting, Strategic Finance / FP&A, Business Operations, or similar analytical roles, with experience operating in a high-growth technology company strongly preferred.

- Financial & Analytical Rigor: Strong financial modeling and analytical skills; comfortable building analyses from a blank page in Excel or Google Sheets, with a high bar for accuracy and an understanding of when additional precision will—or won’t—change a decision.

- Business Judgment & Problem Solving: Highly analytical and intellectually curious, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, reason from first principles, distinguish what matters from what doesn’t, and move from analysis to a clear point of view and recommendation.

- Ownership & Execution: Organized, dependable, and comfortable independently managing multiple workstreams. You take ownership, prioritize effectively, and are willing to move between high-level strategic work and hands-on execution.

- AI, Systems & Data: AI- and systems-minded, with a willingness to rethink existing processes and use AI, automation, and better tooling to improve how work gets done. Comfortable working directly with data; experience with SQL, BI tools, or data visualization is a plus.

- Communication & Partnership: Clear, concise communicator who can turn complex analysis into executive-ready recommendations, adapt the level of detail to the audience, and build strong relationships with cross-functional partners.

jobs.title: Rev Ops Analyst, Compensation
jobs.description:
Revenue Ops Analyst, Compensation

AcuityMD is an AI platform that accelerates access to medical technologies. We help MedTech companies understand how their products are used, why customers vary, and identify opportunities for physicians to better serve their patients. Each year, the FDA approves ~6,000 new medical devices. Our solution helps MedTech companies get these products to physicians more effectively so they can improve patient care with the latest technology. We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint, ICONIQ Growth, and Ajax Health. We're a high-growth AI and Data company scaling rapidly.

This role, will design the compensation structure that translates our top-level strategy into how the commercial org actually operates — the mechanism that turns company goals into what the org is incentivized to do.

Team Mission

Revenue Operations exists to make AcuityMD's go-to-market motion predictable. We build the data, systems, and plans that tell the commercial organization where to aim and what they earn for getting there. Compensation is our sharpest tool: designed well, it drives the behavior the business needs, can be administered at scale, and is understood by every rep it touches.

Responsibilities

- Compensation Plan Design : Partner with Commercial leadership to design comp plans that drive our strategy, model payout outcomes for proposed plans and SPIFFs with the RevOps leader and CFO, pressure-test designs for administrability and rep comprehension, and support book of business and territory analytics

- Plan Administration: Configure and test plan builds in CaptivateIQ, keep plan documentation in Notion aligned to what is live, and administer quotas, plan issuance, acknowledgements, and new hire setup

- Commission Execution: Run the monthly cycle in CaptivateIQ. Reconcile deal, renewal, and roster data, calculate payouts across every plan, and deliver a validated file for Finance approval

- Attainment Reporting: Measure ramp and attainment across AE, AM, CSM, SDR, Solutions, and leader populations, and own the recurring reporting leadership uses to manage performance

- Commercial Partnership: Act as first responder on payout and data questions from the GTM organization, resolve discrepancies to root cause, administer exceptions such as deal transitions, and equip managers to own their team's review

- Territory design: Own for the commercial org, including modeling scenarios, recommending structural changes as the org grows, and updating segment definitions

Your Profile

- 3-6 years in sales compensation, commissions administration, or revenue operations at a high-growth SaaS company

- Hands-on ownership of an incentive compensation platform; CaptivateIQ strongly preferred, with Xactly, Varicent, Spiff, or Everstage experience translating well

- Fluency in plan mechanics: quotas, rates, tiers, accelerators, kickers, draws, splits, and clawbacks

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, and comfort reconciling imperfect data across CRM, CPQ, ERP, and HRIS systems. SQL is a plus

- Highly organized and detail-driven, with the judgment to be the last check before money goes out the door

- Excellent communication skills. You can explain a calculation to a frustrated rep and push back on a request that would compromise data integrity

- Comfort with recurring hard deadlines, and with AI tools as part of your daily workflow

Data Program Associate

We are currently seeking a Data Program Manager to join our Product team and push forward our data products. In this role, you will be responsible for execution on acquiring data. This is primarily via AI driven curation work, building agents, evaluating quality, and ongoing systems to maintain them over time. You will also occasionally be responsible for acquiring new datasets with third parties. This will require close collaboration with peers on the product team to prioritize the right datasets, evaluate ROI and data quality, and ensure the business can make investment decisions correctly.

With empathy for how we collect, curate, and use data, you will use AI both at work and in our official data pipelines to help create and acquire datasets.

Team Mission

The AcuityMD platform features data from across the healthcare industry. Our data assets are the foundation of our application and central to the value we deliver to clients. The quality of our data is paramount for building trust with new clients and maintaining trust with existing clients. We operate in a field where we must constantly search for ground-truth data we can leverage to improve the quality of our product.

Responsibilities

- Build AI agents to acquire new data, define the ways we measure data quality, identify where and how we can improve our data and processes.

- Partner with the product teams to coordinate deployment of the data into the product for customers.

- Help define KPIs on how we measure the quality of our datasets, tied to customer outcomes.

- Execute on new data acquisition with third parties. Including but not limited to coordination, contracting process, and ensuring alignment to the business value.

Your Profile

- 0-5 years of relevant experience (data analyst, light engineering, or otherwise)

- You build empathy for customer problems and seek to understand, question, and improve the user experiences

- A plus if you are familiar with some programming language - python, R, sql, or other scripting language.

- A plus if you have experience engaging external vendors and going through discovery processes.

- You’re exceptionally organized and can drive multiple projects forward simultaneously.

- You’re comfortable with spreadsheets and structuring analyses and summaries out from them.

- You seek hard problems to solve and are comfortable with ambiguity. You often structure your thinking in writing to sort through ambiguity.

- You communicate clearly and concisely, can reason through tradeoffs, and tell stories using data

- You have a bias towards action

- You’re eager to learn new skills around building AI systems and roll up your sleeves to ensure they’re of high quality with evals.
